PhD studies in Computational and Applied Physics
PhD studies in Computational and Applied Physics provide a high level training in the fields of Computational Physics and Applied Physics, as well as supplying an appropriate background in the general methodologies of the scientific and technical research. Our aim is that futures PhDs have the capacity to lead both research and technological innovation in the fields indicates above.
The PhD program in Computational and Applied Physics is offered by the Physics Department of the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya.
